create_async_trainer: create an AsyncTrainer instance with configurable aggregator, learning rate, epochs, and event generator settings
run_fl_training: run federated learning training on an FL model using an async trainer with a data provider
assert_fl_nonfl_same: assert that FL and non-FL training produce equivalent model parameters given the same data and hyperparameters
get_equal_split_data: get an FL data provider and non-FL data loader with data equally split among users
simulate_async_global_model_update: simulate an async global model update by reconstructing gradients and applying SGD with lr=1.0
